গ. $sqrt(3) cosec 2x - sec 2x = 4$ → $(sqrt(3) cos 2x - sin 2x)/(sin 2x cos 2x) = 4$ → $sqrt(3) cos 2x - sin 2x = 4 sin 2x cos 2x$ → $2 cos(2x + pi/6) = 2 sin 4x$ → $cos(2x + pi/6) = cos(pi/2 - 4x)$ → $2x + pi/6 = ±(pi/2 - 4x) + 2n pi$। $+$-এ: $6x = pi/3 + 2n pi$ → $x = pi/18 + n pi/3$; $-$-এ: $2x + pi/6 = -pi/2 + 4x + 2n pi$ → $x = pi/3 - n pi = pi/3 + n pi$।

ক. $cos^{-1}(sqrt(2)/sqrt(3)) = phi$ ধরলে $cos phi = sqrt(2)/sqrt(3)$ → $sin phi = sqrt(1 - 2/3) = 1/sqrt(3)$। $arctan(1/sqrt(3)) = pi/6$। মান $pi/6$।

খ. $a = b = c = 1$: $cos theta + sin theta = 1$ → $sqrt(2) cos(theta - pi/4) = 1$ → $cos(theta - pi/4) = 1/sqrt(2)$ → $theta - pi/4 = ±pi/4 + 2n pi$ → $theta = 2n pi$ বা $theta = pi/2 + 2n pi$। $-2pi < theta < 2pi$-তে: $theta = 0, pi/2, -3pi/2$।

গ. মূলদ্বয় $alpha, beta$: $a cos alpha + b sin alpha = c$ ও $a cos beta + b sin beta = c$। বিয়োগ করে: $a(cos alpha - cos beta) = -b(sin alpha - sin beta)$ → $-2a sin((alpha+beta)/2) sin((alpha-beta)/2) = -2b cos((alpha+beta)/2) sin((alpha-beta)/2)$ → $sin((alpha-beta)/2)[b cos((alpha+beta)/2) - a sin((alpha+beta)/2)] = 0$। ভিন্ন মূলের জন্য $tan((alpha+beta)/2) = b/a$। অতএব $sin(alpha+beta) = 2 tan((alpha+beta)/2)/(1 + tan^2((alpha+beta)/2)) = (2b/a)/(1 + b^2/a^2) = 2ab/(a^2 + b^2)$।
